findings.finding: The merged version distributed attention equally across 12 scenes and lacked a professional scale chain for any one scene.
findings.remediation: Promoted T2, S2 and S7 to hero status with 1:5000/1:2000/1:500/1:200 evidence, routes, staff positions and receipts.
findings.verification: Closed by bilingual A3 pages 8-14 and A0 board 2; structured references in two-answers.json and spatial-atlas.json.

findings.finding: A missing CSS brace collapsed intended grids into one column; page-count checks still returned 20 pages and therefore concealed clipped content.
evidence: original-size raster review of A3 pages 2, 7, 15 and 18
findings.remediation: Corrected stylesheet closure, added computed-layout validation and regenerated all four PDFs.
findings.verification: Closed after full 72/150-DPI raster review, 20-page/3-board page checks and file-size checks.

findings.finding: The protocol described human decisions but did not expose a single inspectable and printable adoption record per scene.
findings.remediation: Added receipt_fields to 12/12 scenes, NOT FIELD-RUN state, allowed decisions and printable receipt UI.
findings.verification: Closed by schema 1.2.0 data and desktop/mobile offline interaction tests.

findings.finding: Station plans did not consistently expose baseline, emergency and removal routes together with staff positions.
findings.remediation: Added route geometries, buffers, section lines, operation windows and human positions for all three stations.
findings.verification: Closed by A3 hero pages, A0 board 2 and interactive station views.

findings.finding: Official survey, ownership, statutory controls, utilities and observed flows remain unavailable.
findings.remediation: Retain provisional-boundary and concept-scale disclosures; require these inputs before professional development.

findings.finding: No scene has been field-run, so outcome targets cannot yet be set from evidence.
findings.remediation: All performance remains unknown; receipts are pending_field_evidence and define measurement methods only.

note: Internal adversarial review only; not an official score, statutory review or field validation.
